note: 'Only in reply to a valid Request': TestRFC3748PeerAnswersNoInvalidRequest (a Request of another method mid-method and a method Request after Success each discarded, a valid Request answered). 'Never retransmitted on a timer': TestRFC3748PeerNeverRetransmitsOnATimer walks PeerSession for a time.Timer, time.Ticker or chan time.Time (none), checks Process is the only method returning *Packet or PeerResult, and shows an answered peer handed an early EAP-Success returns no Response and marks it Discarded. PeerSession has no transport, so Process is its only send path. Limit: the reflection does not look for a func-typed send callback; adding one would also add a send path the method-set check misses. All units recorded.
